design.task: input-only full-day donor coverage and non-identifiability of retained summaries
design.cohort: airport and UTC takeoff day, the existing public departure-delay population
design.donors: explicit VFR excluded; unknown flight rule retained, as in selected public features
design.paired: valid original clock and at least one gated OPDI/ADSB own physical clock
design.new_donors: strictly more than 30 minutes away inside the same airport UTC day
design.aliases: far donors automatically fail the earlier <=120-second input-alias criteria
design.population: all 2025 cached departure inputs; ordinary routing does not remove context donors
design.scope: daily groups cannot mix disjoint allowed UTC months; exact original fold membership retained
design.comparison: closed 16-neighbor local encoder and retained 12 public scalar features
design.interpretation: coverage/identifiability only; no fitted model, predictive gain, or CV claim
